verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a REST API, an MCP server, scoped tokens and sandboxes, but nothing in the evidence shows a journal-entry endpoint or a draft or review-queue state that an accountant could approve. The API, MCP and contacts evidence covers adjacent channels and other resources, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
